purpose: Byte-exact vendored copies of the #2388 benchmark loader modules at the parent pin. The #2388 code lives only on the unmerged issue-2388 branch; vendoring the two blobs makes #2658 correctness prompt-text resolution runnable on lanes without the branch object (fresh pod partial clones, git-less SLURM rsync trees). The .py.pinned suffix keeps the frozen bytes out of ruff/pytest collection; they are loaded by explicit path via importlib (scripts/issue2658_text_resolver.py).
sha_domain: file bytes (sha256 over the raw vendored file bytes; equal to `git show <source_commit>:<source_path>` output by construction)
